CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_pending_opportunity_count(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select count(*)::integer from public.icash_screening_jobs s
 left join public.icash_opportunity_outcomes o on o.screening_id=s.id and o.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=p_account and not public.icash_owner_preflight_empty(s.account_id,s.id,s.snapshot) and s.created_at>now()-interval '24 hours'
 and (s.state in ('queued','running') or (s.state='complete' and s.result->'financialCheck'->>'status'='eligible'
  and not coalesce(o.attempted,false) and not coalesce(o.responded,false) and not coalesce(o.opted_out,false)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_automation_tickets t where t.account_id=s.account_id and t.screening_id=s.id and t.kind='contacts' and t.state='complete' and t.outcome='empty')
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_property_controls c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.property_id=s.snapshot->>'propertyId' and c.manual)
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_owner_contacts c where c.account_id=s.account_id and c.screening_id=s.id and not exists(select 1 from jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(c.result->'contacts','[]'::jsonb)) person
  cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(person->'phones','[]'::jsonb)) phone
  where person->'likelyOwner'='true'::jsonb and phone->'doNotCall' is distinct from 'true'::jsonb and length(coalesce(phone->>'number',''))>0))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_deal_files d where d.account_id=s.account_id and d.screening_id=s.id and d.stage in ('closed','cancelled','cancellation_pending','under_contract','purchase_signed','buyer_selected','assigned','title_open','closing'))));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_search_due_before_provider_quota(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select not exists(select 1 from public.icash_operation_spend o
   where o.account_id=p_account and o.operation_key='discovery:'||c.account_id||':'||c.revision||':'||c.next_page
   and o.state<>'reserved')
  and public.icash_prospecting_available(p_account)>=public.icash_research_admission_quote(p_account,'property_search',r.charge_cents)
  and not public.icash_research_waiting_on_outreach(p_account)
  and (not c.contacts_enabled or public.icash_enrichment_before_prospecting_budget(p_account) is null)
  and public.icash_search_due_before_prospecting_budget(p_account)
 from public.icash_discovery_configs c join public.icash_operation_rates r on r.id=c.rate_id where c.account_id=p_account;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.icash_outbound_search_due(p_account uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select case when public.icash_dealmachine_capacity_available() then public.icash_search_due_before_provider_quota(p_account) else false end;
$function$
